data_fields.name: kills_required
data_fields.donor_constant: per quest script (ParseInt of kills group)

best_idea: A quest task is a list of triggers and effects with a lifetime: one primary always-on trigger can arm or disarm it, disarming rearms every effect, and a parked task rearms its effects each tick until its target is armed.
decision_why: Keep the arm, disarm, rearm and parked shape as zone data on the server; fix the stale prevTriggered after a yield, the yield that skips a whole tick, and the accumulator reset to zero; reject the Unity runtime, the QBN text parser, and the display-name dialogue keys.
acceptance: A server test runs a quest with 'kill 3 imp' then a reward: the reward is granted exactly once; a yield on the arming tick does not init the spawn counter twice; disarming rearms the one-shot effects and a second arm grants them again.
